needs.name: safe_vertical_support_and_shock_absorption_need
needs.text: The main landing gear shall provide safe vertical support and shock absorption under specified vertical landing impact and drop-test conditions.

needs.name: impact_performance_verification_need
needs.text: The main landing gear shall support verification of vertical shock acceleration, piston rod acceleration positive peak limit, compression stroke, bottoming prevention, and post-impact stability.
needs.source: Requirements req8-req13 and derived requirement req29

needs.name: shock_absorber_design_need
needs.text: The tire, wheel assembly, oleo-pneumatic shock strut, gas chamber, hydraulic damping path, seals, and structural load path shall provide the required buffering and load-transfer behavior.

needs.name: environmental_robustness_need
needs.text: The main landing gear shall maintain required support and shock absorption capability under specified landing impact, runway contact, and repeated load-cycle conditions.

needs.name: service_suitability_need
needs.text: The main landing gear shall support inspection, maintenance, wear-item servicing, and minimum safe capability under allowed degradation.

requirements.name: req0
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall provide safe vertical support and shock absorption for the aircraft under specified vertical landing impact and drop-test conditions.

requirements.name: req1
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall satisfy the functional requirements for vertical load support, ground contact support, vertical load transfer, impact absorption, damping energy dissipation, and controlled rebound.

requirements.name: req2
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall support the aircraft vertical load transmitted through the landing gear attachment structure during specified landing impact conditions.

requirements.name: req3
requirements.text: The wheel and tire assembly shall provide ground contact support when the main landing gear contacts the runway surface during vertical landing impact.

requirements.name: req4
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall transfer vertical impact loads from the wheel and tire assembly through the shock strut and structural attachment path to the aircraft structure.

requirements.name: req5
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall absorb vertical landing impact energy through controlled compression of its shock absorption assembly.

requirements.name: req6
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall dissipate impact energy during compression and rebound to support a controlled vertical response.

requirements.name: req7
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall provide controlled rebound after shock strut compression under specified vertical landing impact conditions.

requirements.name: req8
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall satisfy the non-functional requirements for landing impact performance, physical design, operating environment adaptation, and service suitability.

requirements.name: req9
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall satisfy the performance requirements for vertical shock acceleration, compression stroke, bottoming prevention, and post-impact stability.

requirements.name: req10
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall limit the peak vertical shock acceleration transmitted to the supported aircraft structure within the specified limit.

requirements.name: req29
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall limit the maximum positive peak of the piston rod vertical acceleration time history, max_t(piston_zdd_out(t)), to less than 20 m/s^2 during the drop process.

requirements.name: req11
requirements.text: The shock strut shall limit maximum compression stroke within the specified limit during vertical landing impact.

requirements.name: req12
requirements.text: The shock strut shall prevent hard bottoming under specified vertical landing impact conditions.

requirements.name: req13
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall recover to a stable ground-support state after the vertical impact and rebound response.

requirements.name: req14
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall satisfy the design requirements for tire vertical buffering, oleo-pneumatic shock absorption, gas elastic recovery, hydraulic damping, sealing integrity, and load-path integrity.

requirements.name: req15
requirements.text: The tire shall provide vertical stiffness characteristics within the allowed range needed to meet the specified landing impact buffering requirement.

requirements.name: req16
requirements.text: The oleo-pneumatic shock strut shall provide compression and extension characteristics needed to meet the specified impact absorption and rebound control requirements.

requirements.name: req17
requirements.text: The gas chamber of the shock strut shall provide elastic restoring force during and after shock strut compression.

requirements.name: req18
requirements.text: The hydraulic damping path of the shock strut shall provide damping characteristics within the allowed range needed for impact energy dissipation and rebound control.

requirements.name: req19
requirements.text: The shock strut shall maintain oil and gas sealing integrity required for oleo-pneumatic load support, energy absorption, and elastic recovery.

requirements.name: req20
requirements.text: The main landing gear connection structure shall maintain the integrity and alignment of the vertical load path from tire contact through the shock strut to the aircraft attachment structure.

requirements.name: req21
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall satisfy the environmental requirements for specified landing impact, runway contact, and repeated load-cycle conditions.

requirements.name: req22
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall maintain the required vertical support and shock absorption capability when subjected to the specified vertical landing impact environment.

requirements.name: req23
requirements.text: The wheel and tire assembly shall maintain stable contact support with the runway surface under the specified runway contact condition.

requirements.name: req24
requirements.text: The main landing gear structural members, tire, wheel assembly, and shock strut shall withstand the specified repeated vertical load-cycle conditions without loss of required vertical support and shock absorption capability.

requirements.name: req25
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall satisfy the suitability requirements for inspection, maintenance, wear-item replacement, and minimum safe capability under allowed performance degradation.

requirements.name: req26
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall allow inspection and maintenance of the tire, wheel assembly, shock strut, hydraulic fluid path, gas chamber, seals, and primary structural joints.

requirements.name: req27
requirements.text: The main landing gear shall support replacement or servicing of wear-sensitive items associated with tire contact, oleo sealing, and hydraulic damping performance.

requirements.name: req28
requirements.text: When key buffering components experience performance deviation, wear, or degradation within the allowed range, the main landing gear shall retain the specified minimum safe landing support and buffering capability.
